findings.issue: The code correctly ignores a click on an idle button even when the user strips the disabled attribute in DevTools, but no test locks this in. Two separate guards cover it: idle buttons carry action null and the handler checks model.enabled, and useTableSession.act only applies an action when nextStep(t) === 'user'.
findings.evidence: DOM edit (removeAttribute('disabled')) -> click -> onClick closure: model.enabled=false / action=null -> no onAct. Even if onAct were reached off-turn, useTableSession.ts act updater returns t unchanged unless nextStep(t)==='user'; applyUserAction -> applyAction re-validates legality and amount. Button text edits cannot change the action, because it is bound in the closure from engine legalActions.
findings.fix: Optional: add a unit or e2e case that removes the disabled attribute from an idle button, clicks it, and asserts the table state is unchanged.

summary: No BLOCKER or MAJOR findings. Submitted actions: enabled buttons submit only the Action objects from playerView(hand, USER_SEAT).legalActions, and labels are derived from those actions. No free-amount input exists, and editing the label or the DOM cannot change the bound action. Off-turn and idle clicks are blocked three times: idle buttons have action null, the onClick checks model.enabled, and act's setTable updater checks nextStep==='user'. Fast double-clicks land on the updated state and are dropped. applyUserAction/applyAction still validate and throw on anything illegal, so the session fails closed. Hidden information: the bar reads only the user's PlayerView, and labels show only the engine's call/bet/raise amounts. Test-only shim: the Worker/Blob timer swap lives only in e2e/action-bar.spec.ts and runs through page.evaluate. Nothing in src/ references Worker, Blob or createObjectURL, and the existing dist bundle has no Worker references. Dependencies: package.json and the lockfile are unchanged. No secrets, storage, network or randomness were added to production code.
